stations.title: Ines
stations.say: Can I write each rule just once?

stations.title: Copied lines
stations.text: The same rules pasted once for every order.

stations.title: Packing slip
stations.text: A label and a total for every order.

captions: The rules work for one order. Now Ines has six, all at once.
She copies the lines for every order, and one copy comes out wrong.
You write each rule once as a function, in four small tasks.
Now every order calls the same functions, and all six come out right.
Write it once, call it often: a fix happens in one place.
